|lore=Vader’s aide on the ''Devastator''. Personally supervised search for Death Star plans on Tatooine by Vader’s order. Was graduated with honors from Imperial Navy Academy on Carida.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your control phase (twice if aboard ''Devastator''), may use 1 Force to take an Imperial pilot of ability < 3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

|notes=The remastered Players Committee slip for Commander Praji gives official text dated 4 December 2006. See [[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (Original)|Original]] for the earlier wording. Both slips give Praji a control-phase search for an eligible Imperial pilot and permit two uses aboard Devastator. The later slip uses a singular pilot in the named phase under the [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 One Rule].
